summary: Comprehensive testing of Graha-based Mantra Recommendation System (Kundli + Swiss Ephemeris + Multilingual TTS + Dashboard Upaya). Backend 8/8 pytest tests PASSED (100%). Frontend login, sidebar replacement, DailyUpayaCard multilingual toggle + weekday mapping, GrahaKundliPage form submission + kundli generation, and TTS graceful error all verified working.

issues: Sidebar nav data-testid for Graha & Kundli is 'nav-admin/graha-kundli' (contains slash from to.slice(1)); works but unclean. Consider replacing with 'nav-graha-kundli' for consistency.

action_items: (Optional) Normalize sidebar nav data-testid naming to avoid slashes for easier test selectors.
critical_code_review_comments: Good: kundli_engine.py uses Swiss Ephemeris deterministically, no AI guesswork as required. GRAHA_MANTRA_MAP is complete for all 9 grahas with Hindi + English variants.
Good: tts_service.py implements clean provider factory (Google/OpenAI/ElevenLabs) with helpful ValueError when creds missing — propagated to 400 HTTP status (verified).
Good: /api/notifications/today correctly maps weekday via DAY_TO_GRAHA (Tuesday=Mars verified visually).
server.py has grown to ~4867 lines — consider extracting kundli/tts/notifications routers into separate modules (per 700-line rule).

/api/kundli/generate upserts kundli_data but also deletes and re-inserts graha_scores and daily_recommendations on every call; this is fine for idempotency but may be heavy if called frequently — consider bulk_write.
/api/graha/score accepts kundli_id but does not validate ownership (any admin can score any kundli_id). Minor, for single super_admin role not critical now.
GrahaKundliPage form: no client-side validation error toast on failed submit beyond native HTML5 required; acceptable.
DailyUpayaCard TTS error surfaced via console 400 (confirmed) but consider replacing browser alert with an in-UI toast for better UX.
seed_data_creation: Kundli was generated for Test User, Male, 1990-08-15 10:30 Delhi India. Ascendant = Tula (Libra) at 202.44°. No afflictions detected (all 9 grahas in LOW/MEDIUM) — recommendations correctly empty with message 'कोई विशेष उपाय आवश्यक नहीं — आपकी कुंडली शुभ है'.

Backend: POST /api/graha/score — recomputes 9 scores with priorities HIGH/MEDIUM/LOW and 0..100 range
Backend: GET /api/recommendations/mantra — returns list (may be empty — verified)
Backend: GET /api/mantras/all — returns 9 graha-mantra mappings with Hindi+English
Backend: GET /api/notifications/today — day-based notification with correct weekday→Graha (Tuesday→Mars verified)
Backend: POST /api/tts/synthesize — returns 400 with helpful message 'Google Cloud TTS not configured' (graceful)
Frontend: Login at /login with admin credentials succeeds and redirects to /admin/dashboard
Frontend: Sidebar shows 'Graha & Kundli' link and does NOT show 'Nakshatra & Upaya'
Frontend: Dashboard renders DailyUpayaCard with Tuesday→मंगल (Mars/Hanuman Ji) mantra in Hindi by default
Frontend: DailyUpayaCard हि/EN toggle switches Hindi↔English text correctly
Frontend: /admin/graha-kundli loads GrahaKundliPage with form fields (name/gender/dob/tob/place)
Frontend: GrahaKundliPage हिन्दी/English toggle switches labels (verified EN text differs from HI)
Frontend: Form submission generates Kundli — displays Ascendant (तुला / Libra 202.44°), all 9 planets in table with rashi/house/degree/nakshatra, combust/retrograde status
Frontend: TTS Play button on DailyUpayaCard triggers graceful 400 response (console confirmed, TTS error indicator visible)
context_for_next_testing_agent: All graha-kundli/mantra/TTS/notifications features fully working end-to-end. Admin login path is /login (NOT /admin/login). Sidebar nav testid for top-level items follows pattern `nav-admin/graha-kundli` (with slash). Swiss Ephemeris is installed & working. TTS returns 400 until Google Cloud creds configured in Integration Hub — this IS expected behavior. Test user Delhi 1990-08-15 10:30 produces all LOW/MEDIUM priority grahas so recommendations list stays empty (expected).
